title: Australia news live: disaster assistance announced for NSW bushfire victims after up to 16 homes destroyed
summary: New South Wales premier said hot and windy conditions allowed the fire front to jump a 1km body of water. Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Those who lost their homes in bushfires on the mid and central New South Wales coast will receive assistance from the federal and state government. Speaking to the ABC on Sunday morning, NSW Premier Chris Minns said small businesses, primary producers, logistics and transport companies and local councils engaged in clean up efforts will be able to access support. We know that at least 12 homes have been destroyed on the central Coast but that number is likely to be higher. We are devastated for those families. Obviously that’s the worst news imaginable in the run-up to Christmas, exactly what they didn’t need and a reminder of how devastating these bushfires can be. The good news is that transport has been reconnected so that line running from the Central Coast to Newcastle and Sydney will be back and operational as of today which is important tore transport and logistics, but we will roll it from.
